expected_behavior: The reviewer receives only the diff, the spec, and the question — never the session, the conversation, or the memory that produced the implementation.
Every review ends in exactly one of two verdicts: at least one substantive objection grounded as file:line, or the word clean with what was checked.
A review that returns neither objections nor an explicit clean verdict is asked once more for a verdict; a verdict nobody likes is recorded as given, never re-rolled with a new reviewer.
The pass records the verdict as E<nn>-second-opinion.md in the run folder and routes objections to o-fix; it never edits code itself.
